title: Certified partial signal processing for activity recognition and condition monitoring: code and research outputs
description:
Code, recorded per-case outcomes and timing, frozen model artifacts, provenance, and reproducible numerical replay for certified partial signal processing. The study evaluates individual relative multiclass half-Brier fidelity to a frozen complete predictor on UCI smartphone activity recognition and hydraulic monitoring.

Junjie Zhang is the sole author. Original software is MIT licensed. Generated numerical research outputs and original figure artwork are CC BY 4.0; upstream source alignment fields and vendored material retain their separate terms as documented in DATA_LICENSES.md. Raw source signals and source feature caches are obtained from the cited upstream repositories and are not included. Full raw-to-timing execution on a different machine has not been established; demonstrated replay and numerical checks are documented.
